question: Should agent-visible exec, process, and node-host results redact secret-shaped output by default even when that changes byte-exact command output?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proven, but selecting the default balance between internal secret exposure and exact diagnostic output is a security and compatibility contract that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept redacted default
options.body: Merge the security-first default and evaluate any authorized raw-output reveal capability as a separately reviewed follow-up.

options.title: Require reveal design first
options.body: Pause merge until maintainers define and prove an explicit authorized raw-output path with suitable warnings, auditing, and access controls.

recommendation.title: Accept redacted default
recommendation.body: Merge the security-first default and evaluate any authorized raw-output reveal capability as a separately reviewed follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the affected exec/process runtime and were directly asked to resolve this policy choice.
